description:
List the managed lead lists this account has created or synced. 

Use it to find a listId before sync_lead_list, or to check whether a list already exists before create_lead_list makes a duplicate. These lists are held apart from the saved leads, which are separate from the leads stored locally — list_leads shows those. 

Reads only, costs no credits, takes no parameters. Requires an API key. Only this account's lists are returned. An empty result means no lists exist yet.
name: list_lead_lists
